description: A traffic light controller for one road: it goes green, then yellow, then red, and repeats. Module `traffic` with parameters GREEN, YELLOW and RED (defaults 8, 2 and 6: how many clock cycles each light stays on), inputs clk and rst_n (active-low reset), and outputs red, yellow and green, exactly one of which is on.

open_points.point: Which light is on after reset
